manufacturer.name: FAAC
manufacturer.note: Italian gate automation manufacturer. Publishes manuals on its own CDN with document code and revision in the filename. FAAC runs a dedicated documentation site at faac.help, one page per model, alongside its knowledge base and an Azure blob host that serves some PDFs directly. All three are registered as harvest targets.
